# Noto Sans Hebrew

- **Version:** 3.001, static Regular (hinted TTF).
- **Source:** the `notofonts/hebrew` release `NotoSansHebrew-v3.001`, `NotoSansHebrew/hinted/ttf/NotoSansHebrew-Regular.ttf`, downloaded 2026-10-16. The project is <https://github.com/notofonts/hebrew>.
- **Copyright:** 2022 The Noto Project Authors.
- **License:** SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `OFL.txt`. Allowed for fonts by ADR 0036.
- **Coverage:** the Hebrew script.
- **Use:** right-to-left text in `engine_text`'s tests and golden images (`engine_text::fonts::NOTO_SANS_HEBREW`); a game may use it in its font stack for Hebrew (ADR 0102).
- **Changes:** none (unmodified).
